observations.body: Jesus returns from the Jordan full of the Holy Spirit and is led in the wilderness for forty days. After eating nothing, he answers the stone-to-bread challenge from Scripture.
observations.label: Full of the Spirit, hungry, and challenged over bread

payload.posture: Read Luke 4:1–4 as one movement in the temptation of Jesus, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus returns from the Jordan full of the Holy Spirit and is led in the wilderness for forty days. After eating nothing, he answers the stone-to-bread challenge from Scripture. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the temptation of Jesus.
payload.title: Full of the Spirit, hungry, and challenged over bread
